==Description==
The '''Bomber Elf''' was a fast enemy that appeared in [[Cold Ambush]] as part of the [[Violent Night Event]]. It had a fast speed but a low amount of health. However, upon death, it would explode, stunning any tower caught in the explosion.

==Appearance==
The '''Bomber Elf''' had pale skin. It had an orange shirt with white fur along the sleeves, as well as stitch lines on the sides of the arms. It had a black belt, darker orange pants and black shoes. It also wore an orange Christmas hat with a yellow and black hazard emblem on it.

In its hands was a giant present wrapped with black shaded diamond pattern wrapping paper and an orange ribbon holding it together. A lit fuse protruded from the top of the present.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against this.
**The [[Ranger]] can be especially useful, as its high range allows it to kill the '''Bomber Elf''' from a distance. Additionally, it cannot be stunned by the '''Bomber Elf'''.
**These towers should have their firerate and range boosted by the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] respectively.
***[[DJ Booth]]'s [[Range Buff]] also allows your towers to deal with the '''Bomber Elf''' from a further distance, making it less likely for them to get stunned.
*The [[Medic]] can be quite helpful as you can use its ability to cleanse towers of the '''Bomber Elf's''' stun.
